outcome: Complicated birth (instrumental birth, cesarean delivery, anal sphincter injury, postpartum hemorrhage, or Apgar score of 7 or less at five minutes)
cohort: Women with a singleton birth at term after a trial of labor in England
finding: Nulliparous women without risk factors had substantially higher rates of complicated birth than multiparous women without a previous cesarean section, even if the latter had multiple risk factors.
mod_finding: Multiparous women with previous cesarean section had the highest rates of complicated birth, while multiparous women without a history of cesarean section had the lowest rates.
